# Wenbu · 问卜

> Free tools for BaZi, I Ching, tarot and Zi Wei. Deterministic calculations and random draws are separate from optional AI interpretation. Symbolic reflection is not factual prediction.

## Tools

- [Agent workspace](https://wenbu.app/en/agent/): DeepSeek conversations, calculated charts and research from the Wenbu library and selected references. History is saved in this browser; sending a message shares the conversation and selected context with DeepSeek
- [BaZi calculator](https://wenbu.app/en/bazi/): date, time, timezone and explicit calendar conventions
- [I Ching](https://wenbu.app/en/iching/): three-coin method with all changing lines
- [Tarot](https://wenbu.app/en/tarot/): full 78-card deck, one or three cards
- [Zi Wei](https://wenbu.app/en/ziwei/): twelve palaces and named calculation conventions

## Getting started

- [First reading](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/first-reading/): a complete first session with a worked example
- [Choose a tool](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/choose-a-tool/): conversation, symbolic draws or birth charts
- [Ask a better question](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/ask-a-better-question/): examples you can adapt
- [Prepare birth details](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/prepare-birth-details/): dates, recorded times and tool-specific inputs
- [Read AI answers with sources](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/read-ai-with-sources/): calculation facts, traditional interpretations and generated suggestions
- [Review a reading](https://wenbu.app/en/learn/review-a-reading/): save a note and return to it
- [Chinese library](https://wenbu.app/learn/): the same guides in Chinese

## Agent integration

- [Agent event protocol](https://wenbu.app/agent-protocol.md): explicit consent, selected context, SSE events and bounded execution
- [MCP endpoint](https://wenbu.app/mcp): stateless Streamable HTTP
- [Agent guide](https://wenbu.app/en/agents/)
- [OpenAPI schema](https://wenbu.app/openapi.json)
- [Skill](https://wenbu.app/SKILL.md)
- [CLI](https://wenbu.app/wenbu.mjs)
- [Context schema](https://wenbu.app/context.schema.json)
